mariehamn.reuse_status: Public web map explicitly provides iframe embed generation. No open data redistribution licence found in published terms. Prefer official embedded maps; direct tile service technically works but do not infer permission to rehost or redistribute.
mariehamn.terms_summary: Published 29.5.2012; disclaimers of precision, continuity and damage liability. No licence grant for map data.

embedding.status: Both HTTP 200 verified; no X-Frame-Options or CSP frame ancestor restriction in response headers. Derived from actual public EmbedMap._getValues code in imssite bundle.
embedding.parameters: cp=northing,easting in EPSG:3874; z=metres per pixel; ui=z!o!b enables zoom, open full map, basemap selector. layers=basemap label; repeated lon=overlay label.
embedding.verification_caveat: Subagent UI access became unavailable before rendered embedded page check; main agent should verify.

tiles.type: Trimble IMS raster PNG, custom projected grid (not XYZ WebMercator)
tiles.grid_formula: groundSpan=256*2^(17-z); x=floor(E/groundSpan); y=floor(N/groundSpan); tile bbox [x*span,y*span,(x+1)*span,(y+1)*span] in EPSG:3874. Tile images north-up.
tiles.cors: No Access-Control-Allow-Origin header observed. Direct HTML img works cross-origin; reading via canvas requires permission/CORS.
tiles.bounds: Service does not publish global layer bounds in retrieved config; outside imagery extent white/transparent tiles may occur.

postal_map.title: Postkarta över postvägen via Åland, mellan Sverige och Finland
postal_map.author: C J Carlsson
postal_map.date_description: Mitten av 1700-talet according to object description; accession note also says probably late 1700s. Avoid inventing an exact year.
postal_map.attribution: C. J. Carlsson / Postmuseum, POST.044851, via DigitaltMuseum (Public Domain / CC0)
postal_map.georeferencing: Historic hand-drawn schematic map; no CRS or georeference provided. Do not present a traced line as exact road geometry.
postal_map.transcription_note: Visual reading of period handwriting; spelling is not modern normalized. Route order broadly west to east. Some small-print names may need palaeographic confirmation.

atlas_1894.source: Page 015 of Finland in the Nineteenth Century, by Finnish authors; edited by Leopold Henrik Stanislaus Mechelin. British Library HMNTS 10290.i.4.
atlas_1894.attribution: British Library / Wikimedia Commons, Finland in the Nineteenth Century (1894), Public Domain
atlas_1894.caveat: Colours/contrast altered by machine-interpretation scanning process. Not a precise cadastral map.
atlas_1894.georeferencer_status: Redirects to britishlibrary.oldmapsonline.org; service not accessible through web fetch, so no bounds/tiles verified.
